stem:
Which amendment BEST applies to each circumstance described in the table?

Move the correct answer to each box in the table. Not all answers will be used.

options.text: The First Amendment—protects the freedoms of speech, assembly, religion, and the press
The Fourth Amendment—prevents law enforcement from conducting an unreasonable search
The Fifth Amendment—provides legal protections to citizens accused of crimes
The Seventh Amendment—preserves the right of the accused to a trial in federal civil cases
The Ninth Amendment—reserves rights not specifically listed in the Constitution to the people
